title: Attention Is All You Need
blurb: Replaced recurrence in machine translation with stacks of self-attention and feed-forward layers, so a whole sentence is processed in parallel.
intro: The paper's encoder-decoder is built from four ideas: token embeddings plus a fixed sinusoidal position signal, scaled dot-product attention split into several heads, a position-wise feed-forward network, and residual connections wrapped in LayerNorm. The steps build each piece and then the two block types; the capstone stacks them into a full translation model whose output is next-token logits. Decoding with a beam closes the loop.
